identification: Plywood/timber rifle transit case (about 1m long) with hand-painted gold-on-black club badge on lid: crossed rifles between two slouch hats, lettered A.C.P.T.S.A. with number 3684. Webbing sling stencilled M.J. Turner. Green baize lined interior holding two wooden cleaning rods, rag/pull-through, and a leather satchel-type bag. Probably a mid 20th century target rifle club member's case (no firearm).
